verdict.rationale: Metronome is a usage-based billing SaaS, and a natural-language command interface such as an in-app assistant or copilot is a fair capability for that kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack documents only REST APIs, SDKs, Postman, an llms.txt file and an OpenAPI spec. Those make the product machine-readable for developers and agents, but none of them lets a user operate it with natural-language commands.
